purpose: Share an existing simulation dataset and a reproducible CSV-only classifier starter, without collecting new labels or evaluating the historical test set.
command: uv run --locked python run_grasp_classifiers.py --phase fit-csv --model logistic --dataset results/grasp_classifier_comparison_20261115/dataset.csv --output results/grasp_classifier_csv_baseline_20261121
regression_command: uv run --locked python -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_grasp_classifier_*.py' -v
observed_training_warnings: NumPy RuntimeWarning: divide by zero encountered in matmul
NumPy RuntimeWarning: overflow encountered in matmul

warning_policy: Warnings were not suppressed. They occurred in the existing Apple-Silicon NumPy/scikit-learn environment during fitting; finite saved-model predictions were separately checked against scalar dot products. This check does not prove every optimizer intermediate was unaffected.
test_warning_note: The zero-feature LASSO regression also emitted the expected no-features-selected UserWarning.
scope: CSV classifier execution on the current macOS environment; not a new physical experiment or a cross-platform guarantee.
